text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 10: The ENS ensemble mean beats the best no-weather baseline by several points to day 5, and by day 14 climatology is ahead'
text.tspan: Figure 10: The ENS ensemble mean beats the best no-weather baseline by
several points to day 5, and by day 14 climatology is ahead

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of an XGBoost model given ENS minus that of the no-weather baseline with the lowest error at the same horizon, chosen after the run: solar: day 0 climatology, day 1 climatology, day 2 climatology, day 3 climatology, day 5 climatology, day 7 climatology, day 10 climatology, day 14 climatology; wind: day 0 smart persistence, day 1 smart persistence, day 2 smart persistence, day 3 smart persistence, day 5 climatology, day 7 climatology, day 10 smart persistence, day 14 smart persistence. Planned: the ensemble mean against climatology at day 7, for solar and wind; every other mark is exploratory. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, every daylight hour, April 2024 to September 2026. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, every hour, August 2024 to September 2026.'
